title: People: roles and character
goal: Recognise and use 23 words for people’s roles and for describing what someone is like.

example.fr: Dany Laferrière est un écrivain québécois né en Haïti.
example.en: Dany Laferrière is a Québec writer born in Haiti.

example.fr: L'entraîneur de l'équipe de hockey est très exigeant.
example.en: The hockey team coach is very demanding.

example.fr: Son médecin l'a envoyé chez un psychiatre.
example.en: His doctor referred him to a psychiatrist.

example.fr: Le barman nous a préparé deux cafés.
example.en: The bartender made us two coffees.

example.fr: Elle a travaillé comme mannequin à Paris.
example.en: She worked as a model in Paris.

example.fr: L'ambassadeur du Canada au Mexique parle espagnol.
example.en: Canada's ambassador to Mexico speaks Spanish.

example.fr: Je commande toujours ma viande chez le boucher du quartier.
example.en: I always order my meat from the local butcher.

example.fr: Le pasteur a parlé pendant la cérémonie.
example.en: The pastor spoke during the ceremony.

example.fr: Raj a ouvert une boulangerie avec son associé.
example.en: Raj opened a bakery with his business partner.

example.fr: Notre adversaire en finale est une équipe de Calgary.
example.en: Our opponent in the final is a team from Calgary.

example.fr: Le gardien de l'immeuble a les clés.
example.en: The building caretaker has the keys.

items.note: Hockey: le gardien de but (goalie). Québec: la gardienne also means babysitter.

example.fr: Il est le seul survivant de l'accident.
example.en: He is the only survivor of the accident.

example.fr: Son oncle est un ancien alcoolique ; il ne boit plus.
example.en: Her uncle is a former alcoholic; he doesn't drink any more.

example.fr: L'armée a aidé les civils pendant les inondations.
example.en: The army helped civilians during the floods.

example.fr: Le personnel de l'hôpital travaille jour et nuit.
example.en: The hospital staff work day and night.

example.fr: Ce vilain chien a mangé mon sandwich !
example.en: That naughty dog ate my sandwich!

example.fr: Ce vendeur a l'air louche.
example.en: That seller looks shady.

example.fr: Ma voisine est très discrète ; on ne l'entend jamais.
example.en: My neighbour is very quiet; you never hear her.

example.fr: Amira est une étudiante brillante.
example.en: Amira is a brilliant student.

example.fr: Un homme mystérieux a laissé un message pour toi.
example.en: A mysterious man left a message for you.

example.fr: Il a un sens de l'humour un peu tordu.
example.en: He has a slightly twisted sense of humour.

example.fr: Elle est très tendre avec ses enfants.
example.en: She is very gentle with her children.

example.fr: C'est l'une des femmes les plus puissantes du pays.
example.en: She's one of the most powerful women in the country.

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body:
- Many job nouns have a feminine form: [[entraîneuse, ambassadrice, bouchère]]; [[écrivaine]] and [[pasteure]] are standard in Québec and increasingly used in France.
- Québec: [[la gardienne]] is also the babysitter.
- [[Le personnel]] is singular: [[le personnel est...]].
- [[Brillant]] means clever for people, shiny for things.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Repeat each sentence out loud, then record yourself and compare.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Getting something wrong now helps you remember it later.

blocks.prompt: Match each person to the English.
Match each adjective to its meaning.
Who tries to stop goals in hockey or soccer?
blocks.explain: [[Le gardien de but]] is the goalkeeper.

options: Le personnel de l'hôtel est très gentil.
Le personnel de l'hôtel sont très gentils.
La personnel de l'hôtel est très gentille.
Les personnel de l'hôtel sont gentils.
blocks.explain: [[Le personnel]] is a masculine singular noun, even though it means many people.

blocks.hint: The adjective usually goes after the noun.
blocks.explain: [[Brillant]] takes -e for the feminine and goes after the noun.

blocks.text: Raj a ouvert un restaurant avec son ___.
blocks.en: Raj opened a restaurant with his business partner.
blocks.explain: [[Un associé]] shares a business with you.

blocks.en: The ambassador is a very powerful woman.
blocks.explain: Feminine of [[puissant]]: add -e, and you now hear the t.
Feminine of [[discret]] is [[discrète]], with a grave accent.

blocks.fr: Il est le seul survivant de l'accident.
blocks.en: He is the only survivor of the accident.
blocks.explain: [[Le survivant]] is the person who survived.

summary:
- Name jobs and roles: [[écrivain, entraîneur, boucher, associé, gardien]]
- Use feminine job forms: [[ambassadrice, bouchère, entraîneuse]]
- Describe character: [[louche, discret, brillant, tendre, puissant]]
